$comment: dsh-direct MCP server config. Copy outside the repository, fill in real values, keep it private. Exactly one locator: endpointFile (preferred: the plugin writes it at bind time, so a Desktop restart does not break the client) or hostUrl (only for a plugin pinned to a fixed port). Both token files must hold at least 32 characters.

http.$comment: Optional Streamable HTTP transport. Off unless enabled is the boolean true; stdio stays the default. The listener is always 127.0.0.1. allowedOrigins is empty by default, which refuses every request that carries an Origin header -- name the origin a browser client sends, or leave it empty for a CLI client. maxConcurrentRequests bounds tool calls in flight (429 beyond it); initialize and notifications are never rate-limited.
